Trage nur die IP-Adresse deines Cerbo GX: Only enter the IP address of your Cerbo GX / Venus OS / GX device and the Modbus TCP port. Modbus TCP must be enabled on the GX device.
Für die Lovelace-Liveansicht sind 1000 b: 1000 to 2000 ms is recommended for the Lovelace live view. Higher values look sluggish.
Kommagetrennt eintragen, z. B. 100,223,2: Comma-separated, e.g. 100,223,224,225,226,227,228,229,230,245,246,247. The system Unit-ID and control Unit-ID are always included.
Hinweis: Die echten Unit-IDs siehst du a: Note: the real Unit-IDs are shown on the GX device under Settings → Integrations/Services → Modbus TCP → Available services. The scan tries to recognise known register ranges automatically.
Optional: Kopiert die Victron-Energieflu: Optional: copies the Victron energy flow card and three YAML examples into the file storage of the Lovelace instance and exposes the dashboard states to Lovelace. Restart the Lovelace instance once after the first copy or after a card update.
Lovelace-Integration aktivieren (Karte i: Enable Lovelace integration (install card and expose states)
Schreiben ist aus Sicherheitsgründen sta: For safety reasons writing is disabled by default. When enabled, all writable states (controls.*, relays under system.*, writable device registers under devices.* and own registers) are active. Only enable it once you understand the effect on your installation.
Für ESS Mode 2 normalerweise 100. Für VE: Normally 100 for ESS mode 2. For VE.Bus mode 3 a VE.Bus Unit-ID may be required depending on the GX device.
Gilt für alle beschreibbaren Datenpunkte: Applies to all writable states with the unit W.
Hier kannst du zusätzliche Victron-Regis: Here you can add further Victron registers that the adapter does not know by itself. They appear under custom.unit_<Unit-ID>_reg_<address>, are read on every poll and – if 'writable' is set and writing is allowed – can also be written. Take address, type and factor from the Victron register list. Factor = multiplier after reading (Victron scale 10 → factor 0.1).
Name: Name
Der Adapter summiert PV-Ertrag, Verbrauc: The adapter integrates PV yield, consumption, grid import, feed-in, battery and EV charger itself (statistics.*): today, month, year, day curve and a history of the last 400 days. The values survive a restart.
Für „Akku voll in“. 0 = Wert aus Dynamic: Used for 'battery full in'. 0 = use the value from Dynamic ESS.
Optional, z. B. aus dem pvforecast- oder: Optional, e.g. from the pvforecast or Solcast adapter
Der GX liefert über Modbus keine Histori: The GX provides no history via Modbus. With a VRM access token the adapter imports the daily values (PV, consumption, grid, battery) of the last 400 days from the VRM portal and updates them every 3 hours. Create a token: VRM portal → Preferences → Integrations → Access tokens. The installation id is part of the VRM address: vrm.victronenergy.com/installation/<ID>/…
